headlines.title: Putin says he won’t deal with Ukrainian ‘terrorists’ but praises U.S. mediators
headlines.summary: The Russian president’s remarks at a 3 a.m. news conference — and Moscow’s intensifying strikes on Kyiv — suggested that he sees little chance of a deal to end his war in Ukraine.

headlines.title: Watch Ontario, New York, residents sound off on the Lake America name change
headlines.summary: In a Trump-voting town named after Lake Ontario, residents have strong feelings about the president rechristening it to Lake America.

headlines.title: USS Abraham Lincoln docks in Thailand after 9 months at sea
headlines.summary: The crew will get a chance to “rest and recharge” in the beach destination of Pattaya, after reports of deteriorating conditions aboard the aircraft carrier.

headlines.title: Iran retaliates with missiles and drones, defying Trump’s warning
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump had warned after Tuesday's U.S. strikes that any retaliation would see Iran “hit again at a much harder and higher level.”

headlines.title: Russia’s jet-powered drones are overwhelming Ukraine’s air defenses
headlines.summary: Russia is pounding Ukraine with jet-propelled drones, forcing Kyiv to adapt once again in an arms race that is increasingly defining the war.

headlines.title: EU remains divided over trade sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements
headlines.summary: Irish Foreign Minister Helen McEntee says the bloc 'should be moving collectively' in upholding international law.

headlines.title: Powerful storm hits Canada’s Toronto, cutting power to tens of thousands
headlines.summary: Thunderstorm also causes severe flooding and forces flight cancellations at Pearson airport.

headlines.title: US medical groups issue vaccine guidance, urge jabs for flu, COVID and RSV
headlines.summary: Top medical groups say current evidence shows these vaccines protect against severe illness and death.

headlines.title: US’s Chevron, Italy’s Eni to expand oil projects in Venezuela
headlines.summary: Energy firms sign deals in Caracas, days after Venezuela agreed to grant the US control of a fifth of its oil reserves.

headlines.title: Minneapolis shooting kills two, wounds three police officers
headlines.summary: Police say suspected gunman is also dead and that several people, including three officers, were wounded.

headlines.title: Ex-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and wife seek to end drug charges case on immunity grounds
headlines.summary: Former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife have asked a judge to dismiss the drug trafficking indictment against them on the grounds that they have immunity as the leader and first lady of a foreign country

headlines.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer, fines team $30M, Kawhi Leonard $700K in cap circumvention case
headlines.summary: Los Angeles Clippers owner Steve Ballmer was suspended for one year by the NBA, and the team was ordered to pay $30 million for violating salary cap circumvention rules in a case involving Kawhi Leonard.

headlines.title: The IRS slashed its staff. One result? More taxes going uncollected
headlines.summary: The IRS slashed its auditing staff last year — but the move may have backfired as tax collections from enforcement efforts plummeted, an Inspector General report shows.

headlines.title: A jury in Malta acquits a businessman in the killing of reporter Daphne Caruana Galizia
headlines.summary: Investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia had written extensively about suspected corruption in political and business circles in Malta. She was killed by a car bomb in 2017, at age 53.

headlines.title: New Jersey asks Supreme Court to resolve fight over Kalshi's future
headlines.summary: If the high court accepts the petition, it would tee up a case with sweeping implications for prediction markets, an industry that has unleashed billions of dollars of betting across nearly every aspect of modern life.

headlines.title: Pandas' birthdays spark a rush at Australian zoo
headlines.summary: Australia's Adelaide Zoo, home to the only giant pandas in the Southern Hemisphere, is drawing record crowds to one of its top attractions, with the pair of iconic bears from China continuing to grow ties and fueling anticipation of their future offspring as they mark their latest birthdays and approach suitable reproductive ages.

headlines.title: At least 1 dead, six injured in US Minneapolis shooting: local media
headlines.summary: LOS ANGELES - At least one person was killed and six others, including two police officers, were injured in a shooting Wednesday in Minneapolis, the largest city in the US state of Minnesota, amid an active-shooter situation, local media reported.

headlines.title: Sino-European trade looks beyond goods
headlines.summary: Trade relations between China and the European Union are feeling the heat following the release of the latest customs data in mid-July.

headlines.title: Iran urges US to honor June deal
headlines.summary: Iran said on Tuesday it would "immediately" reciprocate if the United States returned to the June deal aimed at ending the conflict, after US President Donald Trump threatened to hit the foe "hard" following the exchange of fire between both sides for the first time in weeks and his treasury chief pledged to keep the pressure on Iran's economy.

headlines.title: Fresh attacks spread across Gulf region
headlines.summary: As fresh hostilities between Tehran and Washington spilled over across the region, US military bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan and Iraq came under intensified retaliatory attacks, following reported casualties in Iran.

headlines.title: Disha Salian case: Bombay High Court orders CBI probe into death of ex-celebrity manager
headlines.summary: Bombay High Court orders CBI investigation into Disha Salian's controversial death after her father's allegations of murder and cover-up.

headlines.title: Eknath Shinde faction argues in Supreme Court ‘legislative majority’ still a factor to decide ‘real’ Shiv Sena
headlines.summary: Eknath Shinde's faction argues in Supreme Court that legislative majority is key to determining the 'real' Shiv Sena.

headlines.title: Maternity leave cannot lead to loss of role or career prospects: Delhi HC
headlines.summary: Delhi HC rules that maternity leave must not hinder women's roles or career prospects, directing the Centre to establish protective workplace guidelines.

headlines.title: Congress cites former Finance Secretary’s analysis, questions 7.8% GDP growth
headlines.summary: Congress criticises Modi government, claiming PR can enhance GDP image but not reflect true economic conditions, citing former finance secretary's remarks.

headlines.title: Dilapidated Rajasthan school building razed after CJP campaign
headlines.summary: Rajasthan's unsafe school building demolished after CJP campaign, paving the way for a new structure to benefit students.

headlines.title: Iran war escalation raises concern over civilian death toll
headlines.summary: The sudden recent escalation has cast renewed attention on the war's civilian toll ​after Iran reported 18 dead in the last U.S. assault, including four killed and dozens wounded at a wedding.

headlines.title: Shares, bonds rally as markets await Fed signals; yen jumps
headlines.summary: Shares and bonds staged a relief rally in Asia on Thursday ​while the yen added to gains as investors awaited fresh U.S. data and central banker comments for signals that could ‌determine whether the Federal Reserve tightens policy this month.

headlines.title: Russia to close branches of Germany's Goethe-Institut after drone spat, foreign minister says
headlines.summary: Russia will close Germany's Goethe-Institut cultural centres, Russian newswires quoted ​Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov as saying ‌on Thursday, after Germany blamed Russia for a drone incident at the Leipzig/Halle Airport.

headlines.title: Yen climbs on hawkish BOJ repricing
headlines.summary: The yen extended gains on Thursday after a sudden burst ​higher in the previous session, though traders stopped short of attributing the move to Japanese authorities and instead pointed ‌to a hawkish repricing of domestic rate expectations.

headlines.title: Gold gains over 1%, US nonfarm payrolls report in spotlight
headlines.summary: Gold rose on Thursday as the U.S. dollar ​and Treasury yields eased, while investors strapped in for U.S. nonfarm payrolls ‌data that could shape expectations for the Federal Reserve's next policy move.
